_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - these are the Design Desk 'noble causes' rules. REPLACE per client. classify_ntee.py reads this file; nothing here is a default. NTEE reference: https://nccs.urban.org/project/national-taxonomy-exempt-entities-ntee-codes

_letter_meanings.good: C=environment D=animals E=health F=mental-health G=disease K=food L=housing M=disaster/rescue O=youth P=human-services Q=international-relief X=religion
_letter_meanings.drop: A=arts B=education(K-12 rescued via override) H=medical-research I=crime/legal J=employment N=sports R=advocacy/political S=community T=foundations U=research V=? W=public/societal Y=mutual-benefit Z=unknown

_drop_override_note: hospitals/hospital systems (E20-24), institutional healthcare foundations (E11-12), international exchange/diplomacy keep-relief-only (Q20-23)
_drop_suffixes_note: any code3 ending in these = alliance/advocacy/professional/research-support org, dropped across ALL letters
_keep_override_note: K-12 / preschool / special-needs schools rescued from the B drop-letter; higher-ed (B40-B50) and alumni (B84) stay dropped
_blank_ntee_note: rows with no NTEE code: keep as good_feel only if FOUNDATION is in this list (10 = church by definition); all other blank-NTEE rows go to the no_ntee file (kept, never dropped)
